Markets.title: US Stocks: US market opens lower as Iran stalemate lifts oil, yields
Markets.summary: Wall Street opened lower on Tuesday due to high oil prices driven by fading hopes for a U.S.-Iran peace agreement and government bond yields remaining near multi-year highs. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 105.3 points at the start, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite also experiencing declines.

Markets.title: Sebi bars merchant banker Corporate Capital Ventures from new assignments for one month
Markets.summary: Sebi banned merchant banker Corporate Capital Ventures from taking new assignments for one month due to multiple compliance failures. The violations included failing to update IPO track records, providing misleading office locations, and lacking mandatory management certifications.

Markets.title: Four Indian private banks eye dollar debt before RBI swap window deadline, bankers say
Markets.summary: Four Indian private banks, led by Kotak Mahindra Bank, are rushing to issue $1.85 billion in dollar-denominated bonds by August 31. The lenders are issuing the debt to take advantage of an Indian central bank swap facility.

Markets.title: Klarna trims full-year revenue, volume outlook as German retail weakens
Markets.summary: Klarna lowered its full-year revenue and volume forecasts due to weak retail conditions in Germany, causing its shares to drop in premarket trading. However, the company reported an unexpected second-quarter profit driven by growth in the U.S. market.

Markets.title: Augmont Enterprises IPO: Rs 825 crore issue price band set at Rs 788
Markets.summary: Augmont Enterprises has set the price band for its Rs 825 crore initial public offering at Rs 750 to Rs 788 per share. The share sale opens on August 21, requiring a minimum retail investment of Rs 14,972 at the upper price band.

Markets.title: Regulatory tailwinds to boost growth for MCX, says HDFC Securities, retains Buy for 18% gains
Markets.summary: HDFC Securities has maintained a "Buy" rating on MCX with a target price of Rs 3,600, anticipating an 18% gain. The brokerage believes regulatory changes, increased FPI participation, and new index options will drive growth in trading volumes, earnings, and capital efficiency.

Geo-Political.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
Geo-Political.summary: Russia accused the UK of escalating the Ukraine conflict by providing British-made drones. In response, Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that the UK remains one hundred percent committed to supporting Kyiv.

Geo-Political.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: Staff at an IVF clinic in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents by using unselected sperm and egg donors. Authorities fear multiple children may have been conceived using these wrong donors.

Geo-Political.title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
Geo-Political.summary: A witness at the Tupac Shakur murder trial testified that chaos erupted on the night of the rapper's shooting. An officer stated that after being shot, Shakur refused to cooperate with police and said he would handle the situation himself.

Geo-Political.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
Geo-Political.summary: German authorities conducted their first raids under a new anti-smuggling law, seizing dinghies and life jackets from a secret warehouse. These operations target criminal gangs facilitating illegal small-boat crossings into the country.

Geo-Political.title: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'
Geo-Political.summary: Former heavyweight boxing champion Wladimir Klitschko stated that his family is experiencing profound shock and grief following the death of his ex-partner, actress Hayden Panettiere, on Sunday. The former couple shares a child together.

Geo-Political.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
Geo-Political.summary: China is censoring public mourning during the funeral of former premier Li Keqiang. Authorities are restricting this nostalgia out of concern that it could lead to criticisms of President Xi Jinping's administration.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift from traditional SEO to AI-driven optimization (AIO) for generating organic traffic.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and streamline their workflow.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create digital media. The platform also provides tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms for monetization.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia conflict, persistent inflation, a weakening currency, and sluggish capital expenditure continue to pose downside risks.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: To protect rural incomes and consumption from El Nino and a weak monsoon, the government is accelerating agricultural spending. Spending on farming and fertilizers is growing at more than double the pace of last year.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research forecasts a $50 billion surplus in India's balance of payments for the 2027 fiscal year. This financial projection is driven by strong foreign currency inflows totaling billions of dollars.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the overall monsoon rainfall deficit has decreased to 13%, erratic weather patterns are causing severe regional imbalances. These variations include a mix of intense deluges and prolonged dry spells across the Southwest.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The government is considering eliminating performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises awarded government contracts exceeding ₹100,000. These businesses currently must furnish guarantees worth 3 to 10 percent of the project value while accounting for half of the central government's ₹2.30 trillion procurement in FY26.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey. Joblessness increased in urban areas while it decreased in rural regions.

India.title: Don't Be Rude: MLA Says Pune Boy's Death Due To Pothole Not Government Fault
India.summary: A Pune boy died in a crash caused by a pothole in his city. Local NCP MLA Shankar Mandekar defended the administration, stating the government was not to blame for the incident.

India.title: Gujarat Chief Minister Woos US Tech Giants In Silicon Valley Investment Push
India.summary: Gujarat's Chief Minister visited Silicon Valley to attract investments from major US technology companies. He encouraged these global firms to establish long-term strategic partnerships in the state rather than just traditional investments.

India.title: Foreigner Sprays Fire Extinguisher In Train, Dies During Railway Police Questioning
India.summary: A foreign national traveling on the Golden Temple Express from Mumbai to Delhi sprayed a fire extinguisher inside the train. The individual died while being questioned by the railway police regarding the incident.

India.title: Mumbai Police Initiate In Absentia Trial Against Hafiz Saeed, 5 Others For 26/11 Attacks
India.summary: Mumbai Police requested Prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam to initiate a trial in absentia against Hafiz Saeed and five others for the 26/11 attacks. The request was made under Section 356 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.

India.title: 'You Can End Marriage,' Jharkhand Candidate Tells Wife Amid Job Loss Fears
India.summary: Employed Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level candidates have started their own protests. Amid job loss fears, one candidate reportedly told his wife that she could end their marriage.

India.title: IIM Bangalore's Architecture: BV Doshi's Pritzker-Winning Vision Mirrors The City
India.summary: Architect BV Doshi designed the IIM Bangalore campus to reflect the city through lush green spaces and interconnected courtyards. His Pritzker-winning vision emphasized open areas for wandering, relaxing under pergolas, and conversing.

General.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
General.summary: Russia has accused the UK of escalating the war in Ukraine by supplying British-made drones. Despite this warning, Prime Minister Keir Starmer has vowed 100% support for Kyiv.

General.title: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
General.summary: A British couple on their honeymoon and their Greek pilot were killed in a helicopter crash. The accident occurred on a Greek island, claiming the lives of all three people on board.

General.title: Serco employee charged with misconduct over sharing asylum seeker addresses in Thetford
General.summary: A 62-year-old Serco employee has been charged with misconduct in public office for sharing asylum seeker addresses in Thetford. He has appeared before magistrates to face the charge.

General.title: PM says he's not embarrassed about hoax message exchange
General.summary: The PM communicated with a person posing as Susie Wiles, the chief of staff to Donald Trump.

General.title: How soon will the drought be over?
General.summary: Rain has recently returned to parts of the UK. It remains uncertain whether this rainfall is sufficient to end the drought conditions in affected regions.

General.title: National Television Awards pick first all-female shortlist for drama acting award
General.summary: The five-strong list features Ella Bruccoleri, Sheridan Smith, Ruth Jones, Vicky McClure and Judy Parfitt.
